name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.236.0 — A project can now send pictures of its real screens through spec-paths pictures; its config's new optional pictures block names the command that makes them, and the plugin names no tool. The round pull worklist now names a note's spot on a picture. The grounding contract hash changed, so projects owe a /spec:doctor re-stamp. 7.235.0 — /spec:connect now adds the token file's line to .gitignore itself, creating the file when needed, and runs in a folder that is not a git repository; it still refuses a token file git already tracks and never runs git init. 7.234.0 — The prototype driver now marks its throwaway worktree as a scratch sink at open and on every ROUND and TESTS step print, so the main-checkout session's edits into the prototype worktree pass the cross-worktree write guard; writes out of that worktree stay blocked.
